claims.text: The December 2009 Congressional Directory records Howard P. 'Buck' McKeon as the senior Republican on the House Armed Services Committee, consistent with a June 2009 succession.

The December 2009 Congressional Directory records Ike Skelton as HASC Chairman and Howard P. 'Buck' McKeon as senior Republican, David R. Obey as HAC Chairman with Jerry Lewis senior Republican, and John P. Murtha as HAC Defense Subcommittee Chairman with C. W. Bill Young senior Republican.

edges.label: Ranking Member then Chairman, House Armed Services Committee
edges.note: Entered the twelve-member group on his election as ranking member, announced by the committee chairman on 16 June 2009, and remained in it as chairman through the 112th and 113th Congresses to January 2015. Longest continuous House Armed Services occupancy of a 119(e)(2) seat in the 2009-2015 window the board's current-holder roster does not cover.
